setting: Privet Drive, Little Whinging, Surrey — an ordinary Tuesday
keepInMind: The story opens not with magic but with a very ordinary suburban English family who are proud of being perfectly normal. Notice the odd little things they would rather not notice.

setting: Privet Drive — nearly ten years later
keepInMind: Baby Harry was left on the Dursleys' doorstep with a letter. His parents were dead, and the wizarding world was celebrating the fall of the dark wizard who killed them.

setting: Privet Drive — the start of the summer holidays
keepInMind: The Dursleys have told Harry nothing about his past (they say his parents died in a car crash) and they blame him for every strange thing that happens around him, like the vanishing glass at the zoo.

setting: The shack on the rock — midnight, Harry's eleventh birthday
keepInMind: Uncle Vernon fled the flood of letters addressed to Harry and dragged the family to a miserable hut in the sea. As the clock reached midnight, someone knocked at the door.

setting: The hut on the rock, then London
keepInMind: Harry now knows he is a wizard with a place at Hogwarts, and that his parents were murdered by Voldemort, whose curse failed on him and left his scar. Hagrid has promised to help him buy his school things.

setting: Privet Drive, then King's Cross station, London — 1 September
keepInMind: Hagrid left Harry a ticket for platform nine and three-quarters without explaining how to find it. At Gringotts Hagrid collected a grubby package from vault 713 on secret Hogwarts business, and in the robe shop Harry met a pale, sneering boy.
The first-years have just crossed the lake to the castle. On the train Harry made friends with Ron, met Hermione and Neville, and refused Draco Malfoy's offer of friendship.

setting: Hogwarts — the first week of lessons
keepInMind: Harry is in Gryffindor. At the feast his scar hurt when the hook-nosed Professor Snape looked at him, and Dumbledore warned everyone away from the Forbidden Forest and the third-floor corridor.
The Gringotts vault broken into on Harry's birthday had been emptied that same day; Harry is sure it was vault 713, which Hagrid emptied. Snape seems to dislike Harry for no reason Harry can see.
Harry has been made Gryffindor's Seeker, although first-years don't normally play. He suspects the three-headed dog on the forbidden corridor is guarding Hagrid's package from vault 713.

setting: Hogwarts — November, the start of the Quidditch season
keepInMind: After the troll, Harry, Ron and Hermione are firm friends. Harry's first Quidditch match, Gryffindor against Slytherin, is close, and he has been training hard in secret.
Hagrid let slip that whatever the dog guards is a matter between Dumbledore and someone called Nicolas Flamel, a name Harry is sure he has seen before. The friends believe Snape jinxed Harry's broom.
Harry now has his father's Invisibility Cloak, and Dumbledore has told him not to go looking for the Mirror of Erised again. The friends still haven't found out who Nicolas Flamel is.

The friends believe the dog guards the Sorcerer's Stone and that Snape wants it, bullying Quirrell to help him get past the Stone's protections. They think the Stone is safe only as long as Quirrell holds out.
Norbert got away safely, but Harry and Hermione left the Invisibility Cloak at the top of the tower and walked straight into Filch, out of bed in the middle of the night.

Firenze implied that the hooded figure drinking unicorn blood was Voldemort, kept alive while he waits for the Stone, and Harry believes Snape means to steal it for him. Someone returned Harry's Cloak with a note: 'Just in case.'
Harry went through the black flames alone while Hermione went back to help Ron and send for Dumbledore. In the last chamber, someone was already waiting, and it wasn't Snape.
